scope: 29 complete documentation prose bodies, 2 complete article prose bodies, 210 UI messages, 11 framework messages and the complete de-data-patch in isolated staging.
method: Read all German prose and interface messages independently, without English comparison during the first pass.
Read all metadata, navigation, brief, prompt and production search vocabulary as German language data.
Excluded protected code fences from linguistic rewriting; API identifiers and inline examples were read in context.
Consulted English only after the full blind read for the two proposed wording clarifications and one optional lexical observation.
Recorded exact staging input hashes before reading; the later final report must bind to finalized production sources and resolved changes.

scoreRationale.terminology: Stable Notiz/Karte/Stapel distinction, appropriate Namensraum and Bildverdeckung, clear ownership vocabulary.
scoreRationale.syntax: Generally natural complete German sentences; one clumsy coordinated verb construction is the only requested syntax revision.
scoreRationale.register: Consistent technical Du instructions, compact headings, qualified claims and no literal translation of the blog wordplay.
scoreRationale.usability: Runnable-task prose is ordered well; failure/fallback messages and count inflections are clear. Numeric-zero display needs a small clarification.

dataNotes.businessMessages: All 210 keys read, including homepage, examples, blog, 404, copy fallbacks, AI form, benchmark qualifiers, machine summaries and one/other count forms. Terminology and tone align with the brief.
dataNotes.frameworkMessages: All 11 strings read. Search result labels, suggestions and interpolation tokens remain understandable.
dataNotes.metadata: All 29 title/description pairs, five group labels and three navigation labels read. Task orientation and distinction between languages are clear.
dataNotes.briefAndPrompts: Entire language brief and prompt/placeholder/contract read. Direct Du register, public API limitations, persistent output and original APKG requirements are explicit.
dataNotes.searchVocabulary: All 31 production topic term lists and every concept/stopword list read. Terms derive from the described work and include German compounds, ordinary variants and umlaut transliterations; no ranking assessment is claimed.

findings.quote: erzeugst v1 und vergleichst und bereitest anschließend v2 gegen das ursprüngliche v1-APKG vor. Erst danach veröffentlichst du sie.
findings.issue: The coordinated verbs vergleichen and vorbereiten have different complements; the sentence attaches gegen/vor ambiguously and makes the reader reconstruct the workflow.
findings.recommendation: erzeugst v1, vergleichst v2 mit dem ursprünglichen v1-APKG und bereitest v2 auf dieser Grundlage für die Veröffentlichung vor. Erst danach veröffentlichst du v2.

resolution.scope: Reread the complete affected German paragraph after the integrator correction.

findings.quote: null ist ein tatsächliches Nullbudget / null bedeutet null, nicht unbegrenzt
findings.issue: German null is a valid word for zero, but in a Node API paragraph it can be read as the JavaScript null value. The actual value is numeric 0.
findings.recommendation: Node: `0` ist ein tatsächliches Nullbudget. Rust: `0` bedeutet ein Budget von null, nicht unbegrenzt.

resolution.scope: Reread the complete affected German paragraph after the integrator correction.

optionalObservations.note: Speicherfehler can also suggest a memory fault. The surrounding publication/durability context makes the intended meaning recoverable; Fehlern beim dauerhaften Speichern would be more precise. The same distinction can be used for Build-/Speicherfehler in rust-api.
